text: We are a manufacturer in Melbourne looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

result.keyword: We are a manufacturer in Melbourne looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?
result.markdown:
For a Melbourne manufacturer that wants to automate order processing, capture shop-floor data and streamline operations **without replacing its existing ERP**, I’d shortlist specialist Microsoft Power Platform consultancies first, then compare them with a manufacturing-focused industrial automation provider.

The key is finding a partner that can connect Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI to your existing ERP, rather than proposing another major system replacement. Microsoft’s own reference architecture demonstrates how Power Platform can support operational workflows while leaving the ERP as the system of record. [learn.microsoft.com](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/architecture/reference-architectures/finance-and-operations-dataverse?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[learn.microsoft.com](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/architecture/reference-architectures/order-acknowledgment-validation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Consultants I’d speak to first

![Inauro | IoT For All](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9xQ-SpjVORg4rtvtpk83IdTSFxN3uZBt0hdV-xWAOcI4bbg3iNQezRbGuOIR4p5dcc2pQtLCUd3WNCUr6BQfCBapA64i2eNH_eELNj14jtTp-rwYDtZbRwFi3nygHZuXSPVoDDP8nTs5bewC1XOMUy1uqVUVQhRiUPhEFnlXeSBHysyZ4-OUDR8uNqZLRcAX?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Inturing

(Best overall fit)

Website: [inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/)

Inturing explicitly targets manufacturers running existing ERP, MES and PLM systems. Its services cover order processing, document extraction, system integration, shop-floor apps and operational reporting. Its published BBCP case study describes automation across MYOB Acumatica, SAP Ariba and SharePoint, with a reported reduction of over 90% in order-processing time. [inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/manufacturing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them about\:** automating emailed purchase orders, validating orders against ERP master data, and capturing production progress and quality checks on tablets.

---

Worth speaking to if your shop-floor requirements extend beyond forms and approvals into production data, machine monitoring, quality records or industrial systems. Its published material describes manufacturing work involving production monitoring, data recording, reporting and digitised defect capture. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/SP+Software+%26+Automation/@-37.9485484,145.0650861,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6ad66c0e6c026659:0x6d1aa5914daaf2de!8m2!3d-37.9485484!4d145.0650861!16s%2Fg%2F11c3mtdf78?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDQwOC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them about\:** integrating machine or production data with your ERP and Power BI, and where industrial controls or a dedicated manufacturing data platform are needed alongside Power Platform.

**Ask them about\:** building shop-floor capture apps and automated order workflows that integrate with your particular ERP without introducing a competing system of record.

**Ask them about\:** integration architecture, approvals, exception handling and production dashboards, particularly if your business already uses Microsoft 365 extensively.

A good candidate for a contained pilot that needs to be reliable, maintainable and handed over cleanly to your internal team. ## 6\. Velrada

Website: [velrada.com](https://velrada.com/) · Melbourne CBD

A further option for more complex enterprise automation involving Power Platform, legacy integrations, analytics and AI. Its described capabilities span process discovery through to automation delivery. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/SP+Software+%26+Automation/@-37.9485484,145.0650861,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6ad66c0e6c026659:0x6d1aa5914daaf2de!8m2!3d-37.9485484!4d145.0650861!16s%2Fg%2F11c3mtdf78?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDQwOC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com.br](https://www.google.com.br/maps/place/Velrada/@-37.8159574,144.9587447,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6ad65d4ccc412997:0x2398e729d3f29054!8m2!3d-37.8159574!4d144.9587447!16s%2Fg%2F11bbrmxsfw?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDUwMi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them about\:** a broader automation roadmap if several departments, multiple sites or complicated ERP integrations need to be coordinated.

## How I’d prioritise the shortlist

| Your main requirement | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Automate order entry and reduce manual admin | **Inturing** |
| Connect production-floor or machine data | **SP Software & Automation** |
| Build Power Apps and connect Microsoft systems | **1Dynamics** |
| Extend existing Microsoft business applications | **MiiiA** |
| Build supportable apps with strong governance | **Hyperware** |
| Coordinate a larger, more complex automation programme | **Velrada** |


These are recommendations based on publicly described capabilities, not a guarantee that every firm has delivered your exact ERP integration. I would validate relevant references before selecting a partner.



## What to ask each consultant

I would give all shortlisted firms the same brief and ask for a small, fixed-scope discovery engagement covering these five points.

- **ERP integration\:** Can you read and write data through our ERP's supported APIs, connectors or integration layer, without replacing it?
- **Order processing\:** Can you extract order details from emails and PDFs, validate customer, product, price and quantity, and send exceptions to a person for review?
- **Shop-floor capture\:** Can operators record job status, quantities, downtime and quality checks on shared tablets, including offline use where required?
- **Data ownership\:** How will you prevent duplicate records and ensure the ERP remains the authoritative source for orders, inventory and financial transactions?
- **Reliability and cost\:** What happens when an integration fails, and what are the expected implementation, licensing, support and ongoing maintenance costs?

For shop-floor work, specifically ask whether Power Apps is sufficient or whether you need an MES, PLC/SCADA integration or another industrial data platform. These are different technical problems, even if they ultimately feed the same dashboards.

## My recommended first step

Start with **Inturing and SP Software & Automation** for contrasting perspectives: one focused on process automation across existing business systems, the other on industrial and production data. Add **1Dynamics** as a third bidder for a Power Platform-focused comparison.

Ask each to propose one pilot, with measurable targets and no ERP replacement. For example, automate one product line's incoming orders or digitise one production cell's job and quality records before expanding.

## What to ask each consultant

I would give all shortlisted firms the same brief and ask for a small, fixed-scope discovery engagement covering these five points.

- **ERP integration\:** Can you read and write data through our ERP's supported APIs, connectors or integration layer, without replacing it?
- **Order processing\:** Can you extract order details from emails and PDFs, validate customer, product, price and quantity, and send exceptions to a person for review?
- **Shop-floor capture\:** Can operators record job status, quantities, downtime and quality checks on shared tablets, including offline use where required?
- **Data ownership\:** How will you prevent duplicate records and ensure the ERP remains the authoritative source for orders, inventory and financial transactions?
- **Reliability and cost\:** What happens when an integration fails, and what are the expected implementation, licensing, support and ongoing maintenance costs?

For shop-floor work, specifically ask whether Power Apps is sufficient or whether you need an MES, PLC/SCADA integration or another industrial data platform. These are different technical problems, even if they ultimately feed the same dashboards.

## My recommended first step

Start with **Inturing and SP Software & Automation** for contrasting perspectives: one focused on process automation across existing business systems, the other on industrial and production data. Add **1Dynamics** as a third bidder for a Power Platform-focused comparison.

Ask each to propose one pilot, with measurable targets and no ERP replacement. For example, automate one product line's incoming orders or digitise one production cell's job and quality records before expanding.
